headline: Golden Knights place Lukas Cormier on waivers
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that the Golden Knights placed Lukas Cormier on waivers and called up Alex Holtz from AHL Henderson. Cormier is being sent down to clear up roster space for the move.

The roster shuffle lands on a team that looks sturdy. VGK are 8-3-0 for 16 points, and they have earned it: they hold 57% of the expected goals (a measure of the quality of chances each side creates) so far this season, and 53% at five-on-five, so the edge isn't just special teams. Their power play generates 0.89 expected goals per game, while the penalty kill allows only 0.3 per game, a lean figure. One thing to watch is finishing. VGK have scored 4.2 more goals than their chances would predict, which suggests some of the record is running hot, though the underlying share says they are good regardless. Their goaltending has been slightly below expectation, at -0.6 goals saved above expected, so the cushion comes from shooting luck, not the crease. Nothing in the data ties Cormier or Holtz to a larger role, so this reads as a minor depth move, not a change to what the team does on the ice.
